system.description: The ground erupts in a violent tangle of briars and roots in a 20' radius at a point within 30'. Sustained. While you sustain it, your feet are rooted and you cannot move.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and every creature inside when it erupts takes 2d6 damage.
outcomes.success: The area is difficult terrain, creatures inside are Slowed, and a creature that enters takes d6 damage. If you sustain the spell for three rounds, the thorns bear fruit: eating one is an Interact action and restores d6 HP.
outcomes.failure: The area is difficult terrain until the end of your next turn, and nothing more.
outcomes.ruin: The roots grip you: you are Restrained until the end of your next turn. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
